Body.Content: Billing is now part of every service blade in the Preview portal. We’ve created Billing journeys that help you slice and dice your billing info and turn it into charts and visualizations that give you at-a-glance insights into each of your subscriptions. When you open your Start board, you’ll see a high-level summary of your subscriptions. Dive into the Billing summary to see overall subscription status, the current charges over time, and the next due date for running charges. Individual subscription data includes status, cost over time, cost by resources breakdown, and other details.
Body.Markdown:
Billing is now part of every service blade in the Preview portal. We’ve created Billing journeys that help you slice and dice your billing info and turn it into charts and visualizations that give you at-a-glance insights into each of your subscriptions.

When you open your Start board, you’ll see a high-level summary of your subscriptions. Dive into the Billing summary to see overall subscription status, the current charges over time, and the next due date for running charges. Individual subscription data includes status, cost over time, cost by resources breakdown, and other details.
